scripts.build: npm run build:client && npm run build:server
scripts.build:client: cd client && npm install && npm run build
scripts.build:server: cd server && npm install && npm run build
scripts.start: node api.js && cd server && npm start
scripts.dev:client: node api.js && cd client && npm run dev
scripts.dev:server: node api.js && cd server && npm run dev
scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix client && npm install --prefix server
